prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a hyper-realistic 4:5 summer street-fashion portrait of an adult woman using the attached approved-adult face reference; preserve her face, facial structure, and likeness. She leans against a textured beige stucco wall in a relaxed contrapposto stance, head tilted back slightly with eyes softly closed as she enjoys the warmth. She wears a sage-mint coordinated fashion set: a fitted twisted-knot long-sleeve top with a flattering neckline and a matching high-waisted mini skirt. Style her hair in a messy bun with loose wavy face-framing strands and use sun-kissed makeup with bronzer, highlighter, nude matte lips, and naturally contoured cheeks. Cast crisp botanical leaf shadows across the wall and clothing with harsh midday sun. Shoot on a Fujifilm X-T4 with Kodak Gold 200 emulation at f/8, using warm yellow-green summer tones, high clarity, realistic texture, medium framing, and no text, logo, or watermark.
